Definition: from G4012 and G5342; to convey around, i.e. transport hither and thither:--bear (carry) about.
BiblicalUsage: Periphero means to carry about, to bear around. Paul says we always bear about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, so the life of Jesus may be manifest in us, and he warns against being carried about with every wind of doctrine.
TheologicalSignificance: What I hold is that there are two carryings: to bear about the dying of Jesus, and to be carried about by every wind — and I must choose which one carries me.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
